pass_a_gloss: Rich martyrs outrank poor: more bonds cut by the two-edged Word; eagle wings home. Pastoral inversion.
pass_b_english: But if anyone, harshly emulating greater gifts and blessing rich witnesses and father-witnesses who shall beget hundredfold children and receive hundredfold fields and houses, asks whether those, beyond the poor witnesses in life, shall have their intelligible possession multiplied — say to him that, as those who endured tortures and pains showed their virtue in witness brighter than the unexamined in these, so those who, besides loving body and loving life, cut and rent asunder so many worldly bonds — using great love toward God, truly taking up the living Word of God, operative, 'sharper than every two-edged sword' (Hebrews 4:12) — could, cutting so many bonds and furnishing themselves wings as an eagle, return 'unto the house of their ruler.' (Isaiah 40:31) Worthy, then — as to the unexamined in tortures and pains first place is yielded to those who in joint-wrenching racks and varied torments and fire displayed endurance — so the word suggests we poor, though we bear witness, yield first place to you, who through love in Christ toward God trample deceptive glory, hunted by many, and so great possession, and affection for children.
